title: MVG Munich transit
description: Live Munich public transport: stops, departures, journeys, disruptions, and lines, over the MVG bgw-pt v3 API. Attach to a route whose upstream is https://www.mvg.de/api/bgw-pt/v3. No credential is needed.
instructions:
Everything here is keyed on a globalId, which looks like 'de:09162:6' and identifies a stop. You only ever learn one from search_mvg_stop, so start there. Never construct one.

The usual sequence is search_mvg_stop for each end, then get_mvg_route between the two ids, or get_mvg_departures for a board at one of them.

Transport types are UBAHN, SBAHN, TRAM, BUS, and BAHN. Pass them comma separated in one string, e.g. 'UBAHN,SBAHN'. Omit to get everything.

Times are ISO 8601 with an offset, e.g. 2026-07-01T09:00:00+02:00. Munich is +01:00 in winter and +02:00 in summer; get it wrong and the journey comes back an hour out.

Coverage is Munich and the MVV area. A stop outside it will not be found, which is a real answer rather than an error to work around.

tools.name: search_mvg_stop
tools.title: Find a stop
tools.description: Searches stops and stations by name and returns their globalId, which every other tool here needs. Always the first call. Returns several candidates for an ambiguous name.

query.description: Stop name or part of one, e.g. 'Marienplatz' or 'Hauptbahnhof'.

tools.name: get_mvg_departures
tools.title: Departure board
tools.description: Live departures from one stop, with line, destination, platform, and real-time delay. globalId comes from search_mvg_stop.

transportTypes.description: Comma separated, e.g. 'UBAHN,SBAHN'. Omit for all.

tools.name: get_mvg_route
tools.title: Plan a journey
tools.description: Journeys between two stops, with legs, changes, and real-time times. Both ids come from search_mvg_stop. Give departureTime to leave at a time, or arrivalTime with arriveBy true to arrive by one.

routingDateTime.description: ISO 8601 with offset. Omit for now.

arriveBy.description: True to treat routingDateTime as 'arrive by' rather than 'depart at'.

limit.description: How many journeys to return. Defaults to 3.

tools.name: get_mvg_messages
tools.title: Disruptions and planned works
tools.description: Network-wide service messages: incidents happening now, and planned engineering work. Filter by type or transport mode. Use this when a journey looks wrong or the user asks why something is delayed.

type.description: INCIDENT for live disruptions, PLANNED for scheduled works. Omit for both.

tools.name: get_mvg_lines
tools.title: List lines
tools.description: Every line on the network, optionally narrowed to one mode. Useful for resolving a line name the user half-remembered, not for journey planning.

transportType.description: Narrow to one mode. Omit for all.

prompts.name: how_do_i_get_there
prompts.title: Plan a Munich journey
prompts.description: Resolve both ends, plan it, and check for disruptions.

messages.content: Plan a journey in Munich from {from} to {to}, departing {when} or now if that is empty. Resolve both ends with search_mvg_stop first and say which stops you picked if either name was ambiguous. Then call get_mvg_route. Finally check get_mvg_messages for INCIDENT entries affecting the lines in the result, and mention anything relevant. Give times, lines, and changes, not a wall of JSON.
